stories.title: Sources: Colts engaged in Jones trade talks as multiple teams inquire about QB
stories.summary: The Colts have engaged in trade discussions with multiple teams involving quarterback Daniel Jones, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Illini's Bielema jabs at CFP rankings: Would be top-15 team if we were in SEC
stories.summary: Big Ten coaches continue to be rankled by the initial College Football Playoff rankings, with Illinois coach Bret Bielema taking the latest veiled shot at the SEC.

stories.title: BYU RB Martin to return from ankle injury, play vs. No. 3 Utah
stories.summary: BYU star RB LJ Martin, who hasn't played since Oct. 3 due to an ankle injury, will return for the Cougars' showdown vs. No. 3 Utah, coach Kalani Sitake told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: Reeling Ravens not expected to deal Henry before trade deadline
stories.summary: Ravens running back Derrick Henry is not expected to be moved by the NFL trade deadline, league sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll
stories.summary: Luka Doncic poured in a season-high 53 points in a 124-118 win over the Trail Blazers, raising his scoring average to 40.1 PPG.
